Dirty Pills?
I am 17 and have smoked cannabis for about 2 years. Also on occasion I have taken mushrooms as these are easily available from a shop near where I live. But for a year I have watched many friends indulge in class A drugs and thought only to steer clear of them. After this year I had started thinking just once wouldn't hurt?, would it?  So finally I decided to take pills - once.
We smoked weed all day anywhere and everywhere. My friend had aquired quite a few pills and we went round a mates house and around 7ish we dropped, I took 2. We decided to go down to the local woods to do some waterfalls before we came up. We arrived and my friends had already begun pulling the waterfalls when I felt a bit dizzy so I sat down. Then I began to feel unhappy and paranoid and my vision spun.
I felt a bit dizzy so I sat down. Then I began to feel unhappy and paranoid and my vision spun.
My mates could tell something was wrong so they went to get me some water. Me and some other mates waited for a while and then walked back to my mates house knowing we would pass the water on the way.
As we were walking I started to feel like waves over my body. Within seconds we met up with our mates and even before I drunk any water I felt fine. After the water the waves became more pleasant and felt good.
When we got back to my mates I was offered another pill so I took it. We then smoked weed for a while then I snorted about half a pill. I sat around feeling hot and cold flushes whilst feeling extremely contented and with deep breathing. After a while I decided to do a waterfall as I had not done so earlier.
After this I began to sweat and rush, I was chewing gum and was loving it. All through this though I had very severe jaw clenching that I noticed occasionally. I did several more waterfalls and began to trip. I saw shattered glass cover my vision and had to look back at many things to see if it was true.
Slowly I began to feel less full of energy and more slow and contented like after I had come up. I soon fell asleep easily.
When I woke up I felt a little slow perhaps but fine.
When I spoke to my friends they said that the pills had not been true to the ecstasy experience and that they were probably cut
- dirty pills. Oh well it happens, I will definitley take pills again at a rave but not regularly. But next time I will be sure of quality as it apparently makes a huge difference.
